svg.title: Allocation latency
svg.text: Time for ClaimSandbox to return a running sandbox · 2 worker nodes · pool of 5 · localhost
Warm: 1,000 sequential requests 150 ms apart · cold: requests that found the pool empty · bursts: median line, min–max band · 0 request errors
Apple M3 Pro · Docker Desktop (Linux 6.12, cgroup v2) · client and cluster on the same machine; network latency between real hosts is not measured.
